name: Vyšehněvice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a black cockerel with red comb and yellow legs and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 December 2015 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
